column1: # CAL partition layout - 4MB ESP32-WROOM-32E
# Asymmetric on purpose. A conventional dual-slot OTA layout gives two equal
# ~1.875MB app partitions
# - about 196KB over that line. Splitting the flash unevenly instead removes the
# ceiling entirely: CAL is small and permanent
# factory holds CAL and is never written by OTA. It is therefore the recovery
# image: a bad application build drops back here rather than bricking the unit
# which matters because the device cannot be serviced remotely.
# Consequence: with a single OTA slot the application cannot update itself (it
# cannot write the partition it is executing from). Updates reboot into CAL
# which performs the download and hands back. See README.
